description: This file defines the NetlinkRequest class, which provides an abstraction for constructing and managing netlink request messages used for network interface configuration and management in Linux. It includes methods for adding interface information, address info, MAC addresses, and managing nested attribute lists. It serves as part of a network configuration utility within the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: NetlinkRequest
classes.description: A class providing an interface to build netlink request messages for network configuration, supporting methods to add various types of network interface attributes and manage nested attribute lists.

methods.name: AddString
methods.description: Adds a string attribute to the netlink request with specified type.

methods.name: void AddInt(uint16_t type,T value)
methods.description: Templated method to add an integer attribute of any integral type to the netlink request.

methods.name: AddIfInfo
methods.description: Adds interface information, including index and operational status.

methods.name: AddAddrInfo
methods.description: Adds address information associated with a network interface.

methods.name: AddMacAddress
methods.description: Adds a MAC address to the request.

methods.name: PushList
methods.description: Begins a new nested attribute list.

methods.name: PopList
methods.description: Ends the current nested attribute list.

methods.name: RequestData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the constructed request data buffer.

methods.name: RequestLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the request data buffer.

methods.name: SeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number for the request.

methods.name: AppendRaw
methods.description: Appends raw data to the request buffer.

methods.name: ReserveRaw
methods.description: Reserves space in the request buffer.

methods.name: T * Append(const T & data)
methods.description: Templated method to append data of any type to the request buffer.

methods.name: T * Reserve()
methods.description: Templated method to reserve space for data of any type.
